title: Word-position context test: frozen role mapping and boundary controls
statement: This commit publishes the plan and executable before calibration or evaluation outcomes. Later calibration cutoffs will be published before evaluation.
check: Run the embedded protocol in calibrate then evaluate phases and compare output hashes.

plan.hypothesis: Role-correct start/middle/end conditioning improves the bilateral context test on new contrasts and reduces deterministic-boundary artifacts.

scores.unconditioned: (JS(prev(C),prev(A))+JS(next(C),next(B)))/2, identical definition to previous bilateral JS.
scores.position_all: For each C stratum (initial I, final F), compare prev(C|I,F) to prev(A|I,not-final) and next(C|I,F) to next(B|not-initial,F); average the two JS divergences and weight by C stratum counts.
scores.position_info: Use the same strata and role-correct references, but exclude deterministic left contexts when C is initial and right contexts when C is final. Sum count-weighted informative-direction JS values and divide by the count-weighted number of informative directions. A candidate occurring only as a one-letter word has no informative direction and is unscorable.

plan.js: Equal-weight Jensen-Shannon divergence, base-2 logarithms, zero terms omitted, no smoothing. Each word has explicit virtual space boundaries. All streams use single spaces.
plan.eligibility: Candidate and each component count >=40. For each conditional reference actually used, require >=20 occurrences in that reference position class. position_info additionally requires >=40 candidate occurrences with at least one informative direction. Unsupported scores are None, reported as abstentions. Primary paired comparisons and calibration use cases where all three scores are available for both X and Z.
plan.windows: Normalize with pinned refcorpus. Calibration: calib_text from character 40000 onward. Evaluation: control_text from character 80000 onward. Training negative chains: train_text from character 40000 onward. Drop the leading partial word after the offset, take up to 40000 characters, drop the last partial word, and surround with spaces. Remaining evaluation text is shorter for Latin and Italian; report length and exclusions without length tuning.
plan.pairing: Match target AB and decoy AD by word-initial/word-final flags. Modes slots, left (also previous glyph), both (also previous and next glyph). Shuffle occurrence lists per group, pair them, exclude edits with start distance <3 or within 2 positions of an earlier accepted start, then shuffle accepted pairs. Replace targets by X and decoys by Z in the same stream.
plan.decision: Lower loss wins; differences <=1e-12 are ties. Seeds reuse the same source and are robustness repeats, not independent evidence units. Report all six contrasts separately.
plan.threshold: For each score, pool common-eligible primary calibration Z losses, sort n values, and choose zero-based order statistic floor(0.05*n). Accept strictly below cutoff-1e-12. Publish cutoffs and their file hash before any evaluation outcomes. If n=0, report unavailable, with no replacement threshold.
plan.diagnostics: Separate from primary calibration: evaluate us/um on the old Latin evaluation window (control offset40000) using old seeds58471,58477,58481,58487,58493, left/full coverage, and on the new Latin evaluation window using the new seed list. The old window is already exposed and cannot provide independent validation. Its old expected source SHA256 is b16a76590cd083c88a3e94d7c41a9a7102ff20a78e92848a7ec25d61acb1fa93.
plan.negative_controls: Score every lower-case candidate C distinct from A and B, count>=40, for every fixed primary component pair on untouched evaluation streams and 20 new direct-emission first-order chains per language. Fit a shared character transition table on the specified fresh training window; sample starts from word starts, forbid final space, generate len(evaluation_source)-2 characters and wrap in spaces. Report accepted/supported/abstained candidate counts by method, and stream-level any acceptance, plus the all-method common-supported subset.
plan.structural_checks: Verify JS entropy identity, reversal with swapped A/B, equal input-context ties, and the one-letter-word boundary trap using synthetic x/ab/aba/bab words. position_all must score a standalone x as zero if references exist; position_info must abstain. Record whether frozen thresholds accept that zero, without changing the rule.
plan.manuscript_gate: No manuscript candidate triplets will be evaluated; selected reference controls do not settle glyph composition.
plan.stop_rule: No contrast, weight, seed, support, window, threshold or matching changes after outcomes. Bugs require a documented amendment and new plan hash.
